title: Video Chapters
description: metadata_variants.chapters — computed deterministically by persist_metadata_variants() from the voiceover's own timing package (the same timeline the final render's duration comes from), never from LLM-supplied timestamps. Labels come from the LLM's chapter_labels input (see publication-metadata-response.schema.json), matched to sections by section_id. See docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#chapters.

start_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the final video. The first chapter is always 0.
